title: Machine Learning with <sup>18</sup>F-Sodium Fluoride PET and Quantitative Plaque Analysis on CT Angiography for the Future Risk of Myocardial Infarction
summary: XGBoost combined clinical data, CT plaque measurements and sodium fluoride PET imaging to predict myocardial infarction in a cohort with coronary artery disease.
ai_technology: Primary Methods/Results: XGBoost combines clinical variables, quantitative CT plaque and 18F-NaF PET in 293 CAD participants; 22 infarctions accrued over median 53 months; repeated held-out 10-fold testing compared models. Small event count limits precision and no external validation is shown.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: In 293 participants, 22 infarctions accrued over a median 53 months. The study compared models by repeated held-out ten-fold testing.
evidence.unknown: The small event count limits precision. The source did not report an external cohort.
